admission.justification: Unit tests and nine synthetic fixtures verify all ten admitted declaration kinds, nested := handling and default-deny refusals, preventing silent misparsing or mid-signature splitting of upstream Lean files.

applicability: Closed-world top-level Lean 4 declaration and import extraction in src/rh_pipeline/lean/parser.py.
conditions: Normalizes CRLF/CR line endings, tracks nested block comments, strings, raw strings, char literals, guillemet names and four delimiter pairs ((), [], {}, ⦃⦄) to locate top-level := at depth 0, permits unclosed section frames to EOF and enforces balanced namespace/end.

Any unlisted top-level command, local/scoped modifier or attribute, depth-0 termination_by/decreasing_by, anonymous instance, unbalanced namespace/end, orphan doc/attribute or unclosed literal/comment/delimiter raises UnsupportedLeanFormError(rel_path, line, form).
exclusions: Syntactic namespace qualification rewrites only the declared name span and does not rewrite internal signature tokens; opaque accepts either no body or an explicit := body.
statement: extract_declarations parses admitted top-level Lean 4 forms using delimiter-depth-aware scanning for top-level := (supporting unclosed sections, balanced namespaces, Unicode/dotted/prime/guillemet names, where+deriving blocks, and term/tactic proofs) while failing closed with UnsupportedLeanFormError(rel_path, line, form) on any unsupported construct.
title: Closed-world delimiter-aware Lean 4 declaration extractor
